name: Cleopatra Philopator
summary: Innovative and solution-focused web developer with over 5 years of experience in designing, developing, and managing complex websites and web applications. Proven track record in enhancing user experience and optimizing web performance.

description: Led a team of developers to design and launch a new e-commerce platform that increased sales by 25%.
Collaborated with UX designers to improve website usability, resulting in a 50% decrease in bounce rate.
Implemented responsive web design principles to enhance the product display on various devices.
Assisted in the development of client websites using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
Maintained and updated existing client sites, ensuring compatibility with new web standards.
Participated in weekly team meetings to discuss project updates and address client feedback.

extra_info.title: Projects
items: Personal Portfolio Website: Developed a portfolio to showcase projects and skills using React.
Blog Platform: Created a full-stack blog application with user authentication and CRUD operations using Node.js and MongoDB.
